title: Design System: RoyalBite Fine Dine Restaurant

narrative.overview: Earthy luxury where candlelight meets courtyard greenery. Warm ivory canvas with deep olive grounding and harvest amber conviction.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, earthy palette anchored by Ivory, Olive, and Amber
Serif/sans dual voice: Cormorant for heritage, DM Sans for clarity
Organic elevation: tinted box-shadows in Olive-green, not grey
Pill filter chips and CTA buttons; gently rounded content cards
Single signature circle geometry in hero dish

rules.name: The Amber Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Amber covers <= 15% of any screen. Its warmth is the conviction point.

rules.name: The No-Cold-Grey Rule
rules.body: No cool greys. Every neutral is warm (Ivory, Sand, Sage).

rules.name: The Circle Singularity Rule
rules.body: The circular dish ring in the hero is the system's only circle.

dos: Do use Cormorant Garamond for all headings and prices.
Do use Harvest Amber (#E58B24) only for eyebrows, active badges, and focus accents.
Do keep touch targets >= 44px for thumb accessibility.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000) or cold grey.
Don't apply pill shape to content cards.
Don't stack more than two fonts in one component.
